How to choose a clinic and 5 checkpoints so you won't regret double plastic surgery

Failure in choosing a clinic is more important than a mistake in choosing a surgical method.I didn't have any criteria to choose from.There are many cases caused by this.

Judging only by price and popularity,Doctor's technical abilityYou may end up undergoing treatment without being aware of any deficiencies in the warranty.

5 points to check when choosing a clinic
    • Check the doctor's qualifications (plastic surgeon/JSAPS)
    • Check whether counseling is provided by the doctor himself/herself
  • Confirm the applicable conditions and period of the warranty system in writing.
  • See the number of case photos and the degree of publication of postoperative progress
  • Eliminate the risk of additional costs by checking whether the total price is displayed

There is a clinic in Tokyo that handles double plastic surgery.Hundreds or moreHowever, the common thing among those who received highly satisfied treatments is that theyCompare based on specific criteriaThat's what I was doing.

Below, we will explain in order the five items to check that are often overlooked when choosing a clinic.

Check the doctor's qualifications based on the plastic surgeon/JSAPS qualifications.

The first thing you need to check is the qualifications of the doctor who will be in charge of double plastic surgery.Plastic surgeon/JSAPS qualificationsis.

The plastic surgeonJapan Medical Specialist OrganizationThis is a qualification certified by , and acquisition requires a certain number of years of training in the field of plastic surgery and passing an exam.

JSAPS isJapanese Society of Plastic SurgeryThis qualification is accredited by a plastic surgeon, and has stricter examination standards than those for plastic surgeons.

What is Plastic Surgeon/JSAPS?
  • plastic surgeon: Certified by the Japan Medical Specialist Organization. Requires a certain number of years of training and passing an exam
  • JSAPS: Certified by the Japanese Society of Plastic Surgery. Examination standards are even stricter than those of plastic surgeons
  • No specific qualifications are required to call yourself a cosmetic surgeon, so it is important to check the qualifications individually.
  • How to check: Clinic official website or Japanese Society of Plastic Surgery search page

Double plastic surgery is often performed at cosmetic surgery clinics, and in order to call themselves a cosmetic surgeon,No specific qualifications required。

As a result, there are cases in which the procedures are performed by doctors who have not received training focused on plastic surgery.

If a clinic's website only lists "Cosmetic Surgeon", you will need to check individually to see if they are plastic surgeons or JSAPS qualified.

Check the clinic's official website to find out if you are eligible or not.Japanese Society of Plastic Surgery search pageYou can check it out.

If a clinic does not clearly state the qualifications of the doctor in charge, we recommend that you check directly with them during your consultation.

The key to determining technical ability is whether counseling is handled by the doctor himself.

Counselors are in charge of counseling and can talk to doctorsJust a few minutes before the procedureThere are many clinics like this.

At clinics where doctors themselves provide counseling, they directly examine the condition of your eyelids and thenDetermine suitability of surgical procedureYou can do it.

Specifically, we take into account the thickness of the eyelid skin, the amount of fat, and the presence or absence of ptosis.Burial method and incision methodIt is common to choose one of the following.

What can be confirmed through doctor counseling
  • Evaluation of eyelid skin thickness and fat content
  • Checking for ptosis
  • Determining whether burial method or incision method is appropriate
  • Compatibility of desired design and eyelid condition

These judgments cannot be made by a counselor, and appropriate recommendations can only be made after a doctor actually examines the eyes.

If a doctor does not appear during counseling,The choice of surgical method is decided without a doctor's consultationThere is a risk.

If you check in advance whether you will be able to see a doctor directly during your consultation, it will be easier to understand what will happen on the day of your consultation.

Also, in counselingforce a contractClinics tend to be prone to post-procedure problems.

If you are asked to make an immediate decision on the spot, it is wise to take it home and take some time to consider it.

If you have not received any explanation, if you have other concerns, or if you are recommended a procedure that you do not want, please get a thorough explanation from your doctor, think again, and then decide whether to undergo the procedure!

The guarantee system for double plastic surgery varies greatly depending on the clinic.

The main items to check are the condition covered by the warranty (does it only occur when the thread comes off, or does it also include changes in width?), the warranty period (1 year, 3 years or lifetime warranty?), and whether additional costs will be incurred for re-treatment.

3 things to check before signing a guarantee system
  • Target condition: Is it only when the thread comes off, or does it also include changes in width?
  • Warranty period:1 year, 3 years, or lifetime warranty
  • Cost of re-treatment: Whether additional costs will be incurred

For example, even if the product is listed as a "lifetime guarantee," there may be restrictions such as "participation in regular checkups is required" or "changes in lifestyle after surgery are not covered."

Be sure to check the warranty contents not only verbally but also in writing or in the terms and conditions on the website. Trouble has actually occurred where the oral explanation differs from the written content.

As a patient, it is important to ask for time to read the warranty terms and conditions before signing the contract.natural rightis.

The number of case photos and the degree of publication of postoperative progress indicate credibility.

As a clue to externally judge a clinic's technical capabilities,Quality and quantity of case photosis a valid indicator.

Case photos with high credibility include before surgery, immediately after surgery, one month after surgery, andMore than 3 months after surgeryThe progress is listed in chronological order.

How to identify reliable case photos
  • Pre-surgery, immediately after surgery, 1 month after surgery, and over 3 months after surgery are listed in chronological order.
  • I have a case similar to my own eyelid condition (single eyelid, deep double eyelid, thick eyelid, etc.)
  • A variety of cases are published without being biased towards a specific width or design.
  • There are multiple progress photos taken over 1 month after surgery.

In cases where only photos immediately after the surgery are posted, the results after the swelling has gone down,Unable to confirm changes over time。

In addition, if the cases listed are biased toward a specific width or design, that clinic can handle the case.The range of surgical techniques is limitedPossibly.

Clinics that post multiple progress photos taken at least one month after surgery can be evaluated as evidence that they are confident in the results after downtime.

When choosing a clinic, check to see if the clinic has cases similar to your eyelid condition (single eyelids, deep double eyelids, thick eyelids, etc.).

Difference between burial method and incision method and how to choose the surgical method that suits you

Both the burial method and the incision method create double lines, but since the approach to the eyelids is fundamentally different, if you choose a method that does not suit your eye condition,Prolonged downtime and early double lossIt leads to

Characteristics of the burial method and incision method and points for choosing the surgical method

  • Swelling length and semi-permanent persistence of the incision method
  • Judging suitability of surgical method based on eyelid thickness and fat amount
  • Cost, duration, and risk for each number of points fixed using the burial method

Most clinics in Tokyo handle both types of surgery, but it is recommended that you understand the characteristics of each type of surgery in advance in order to receive appropriate suggestions from your doctor during counseling.

The burial method has less swelling and short downtime, but the duration varies from person to person.

In the burial method, the eyelid skin andEyelid plateThis is a procedure in which the skin is tied with thin medical thread to form a double line.

Because no scalpel is used, there is no scar left, and post-operative swelling is often minimal, and it is not uncommon for patients to be able to return to their daily activities the day after the procedure.

The estimated downtime is3 days to 1 weekThe main reason why it is chosen by people who have difficulty taking time off from work or school is that it takes only a short time to be able to cover the swelling with eye makeup.

Estimated downtime for burial method
  • peak of swelling:3-7 days after surgery
  • Interference with daily life: Relief in 1-2 weeks
  • Elimination of internal bleeding: Approximately 1 to 2 weeks
  • duration:3-5 years to 10 years or more depending on individual differences

On the other hand, due to the structure that is only fixed with thread, it may cause friction to the eyelids or the condition of the skin.Risk of threads coming loose or coming offThere is.

The conditions for applying the guarantee (definition of period, number of times, and covered methods) vary depending on the clinic, soConfirm in writing before signing contractPlease keep it.

The incision method can be expected to last semi-permanently, but post-operative swelling tends to persist for a long time.

The incision method is a surgical method that creates a double line by making a direct incision on the eyelid skin, allowing excess skin and fat to be removed at the same time.

Because a double structure is physically created by suturing the skin and internal tissues, there is no concept that the threads will come off.Can be expected to last semi-permanently。

However, the swelling and internal bleeding after surgery are clearly greater than with the burial method, and it takes time for the finished shape to stabilize.About 3 to 6 monthsIt is common that it takes.
